name: WRS
note: Technical partner of the Ducati Lenovo Team: on Ducati's partner page its logo, which links to wrs.it, stands under 'Technical partners' with the line 'Motorcycle Windscreens and Accessories' (Wayback Machine captures of 23 May and 18 Sep 2026); also a MotoGP partner of Red Bull KTM (ktm.com partner logos), and a technical sponsor of the Pertamina Enduro VR46 Racing Team (2026 team Sponsors page). Left unrated: the brand belongs to WRS S.r.l. of Cattolica, Italy (wrs-ownership), but who holds the company isn't sourced.
